purpose: Certify zero scoring-event absence for an already confirmed roster player, without asserting blanket player-stat completeness.
proof_scope: whole regular-season NFL week; all scheduled games must be complete and bind to source-complete PBP with exact actor coverage
required: replay frozen source hashes before deriving certificates
game identities, season, week and teams match the complete raw schedule
PBP reaches zero remaining regulation time and reconciles final team scores
all core scoring-play actors and nonzero lateral-yardage actors have exact GSIS identity
all PBP player-ID fields are inspected, including non-scoring and deleted plays as conservative exclusions
published potentially scoring players are represented in PBP identities
fumble, lost-fumble and interception-TD event receipts remain EXACT_EVENT_READY
candidate has existing exact canonical roster and completed team-game evidence
candidate has no published player-stat row and no PBP actor occurrence anywhere in the NFL week
blocked: incomplete, abandoned, missing or score-inconsistent games
absent player-week roster membership, including omitted bye memberships
roster status alone, name matching, adjacent-week team carry-forward, inferred transaction dates
overwriting any observed, incomplete numeric or existing complete outcome
label_policy: copy into a new population revision; append source certificate fields; only certified absent-event rows become CONFIRMED_SOURCE_NO_EVENT_ZERO
feature_policy: preserve previously issued feature frames, models and forecasts byte-for-byte; do not invent raw opportunity inputs
evaluation_policy: apply new exact targets to previously issued outer predictions; report old and newly observable cohorts separately; this is a post-selection stress audit, not fresh confirmation or retraining
